# Apollo Brand Identity Reference

Complete specifications for Apollo's visual identity including colors, typography, logos, and usage guidelines.

---

## Colors

### Core palette

| Role | Name | Hex | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary | Apollo Sun | #FBF500 | CTAs, highlights, key accents |
| Dark | Stone | #252521 | Dark backgrounds, body text on light |
| Light | Off-White | #F9F9F6 | Light backgrounds, cards |

Apollo Sun (#FBF500) is **never** used for body text. Always ensure WCAG AA contrast on all text-on-background combinations.

### Apollo Sun spectrum

| Swatch | Hex |
|---|---|
| Sun 50 | #FFFEDA |
| Sun 100 | #FBFABF |
| Sun 500 (core) | #FBF500 |
| Sun 600 | #B8B77A |
| Sun 700 | #949664 |
| Sun 800 | #70724F |

### Neutrals spectrum

| Swatch | Hex |
|---|---|
| Neutral 50 (Off-White) | #F9F9F6 |
| Neutral 100 | #EDEEE2 |
| Neutral 200 | #D3D4C6 |
| Neutral 300 | #BABBAE |
| Neutral 400 | #8F9186 |
| Neutral 500 | #696B5E |
| Neutral 600 | #53554A |
| Neutral 700 | #383932 |
| Neutral 800 (Stone) | #252521 |
| Neutral 900 | #181816 |

Additional color families (Green, Teal, Blue, Purple, Pink, Red) each follow a 50-900 scale consistent with the above convention.

---

## Typography

- **SeasonMix Variable Font**: weight 550 always. Fallback: Georgia, serif. Display 72px, H1 48px, H2 32px, H3 24px.
- **ABC Diatype**: Regular 400, Medium 500, Bold 700. Fallback: Helvetica Neue, sans-serif. Body 16px, Body sm 14px, Label 12px.

---

## Logo

### Embedded logo SVGs

The SVG logos below are embedded directly in this reference file. When the user requests a logo, copy the correct SVG source from below and embed it in the output (artifact, HTML, document, etc.). Choose the right variant based on the background context. Always respect the usage rules that follow.

---

## Logo usage rules

- **Clear space**: 50% of symbol height on all sides — no text, imagery, or UI elements inside this zone.
- **Min sizes**: Wordmark 120px digital / 35mm print. Symbol 35px digital / 15mm print.
- **Approved backgrounds**: #252521, #F9F9F6, #FBF500.
- **Never** alter, distort, stretch, rotate, or recolor outside the approved palette.
- **Never** place the light logo on a light background or the dark logo on a dark background.
- **Never** use the color logo on white or near-white backgrounds without sufficient contrast validation.

---
